answer: Treat each head as an island with its own weather: reputation is measured by how well its predictions match what later actually happened on its shore, so a clone must keep forecasting correctly to stay afloat rather than inherit a score. Heads may wander between islands only by physically carrying a load of attested work, and the crossing costs a fraction of that load, which makes migration of a farm uneconomical. Standing is then cut as timber: only logs whose rings show one growth layer per epoch count, and a spliced or painted ring is rejected by any inspector.
